results.description:
Lowpoly 3d model. 4k textures best fit for Standart (Specular Setup) for Unity3d 5.x+, 2017+
The model splited to 11 parts. So You can animate it, replace with others (battle sights, for example).
Real world scale size model.
The model consists of separate parts that can be rigged and animated if need.
Triangle count around 12000 tris.
There are 2 texture sets. Colored in black and desert style. 4k size each.
Enjoy! :)

results.name: '97 ADI Bushmaster
results.description:
Showcase of a 1997 Australian Defence Industries Bushmaster Protected Mobility Vehicle, I’ve made for project ZOMBOID, low poly but with a high detail texture, optimized for game engine. This version is not a 100% true to the original since there are some compromises I’ve had to make to present it here.

You can find the actual version in project ZOMBOID STEAM Workshop.

results.name: Arbiter 450 Bushmaster - Sawed off AR
results.description:
Technically this model of gun was... can shooter, but no one really want that so I modified tube to be semi-supressor-handguard-thing and i chambered it with 450 bushmaster, because its just nice caliber for such weird gun.
Originally at the end of the grip there was some visible buffer tube but I realize that there should be no problem to cut it off and hide totally in grip for such big caliber...

There is rigged version in fbx and dae format. Gun have one 4k PBR material.

Model is game ready.

Made in Blender.

results.name: Customized ACR BushMaster
results.description:
ACR Bushmaster with some Cyberpunky decals.
Seems theres been a lot of replacements to the gun, but overall the gun is fairly well maintained.

Game Ready model and textures.

Used to be my favourite game when I played Combat Arms back in the day, 
Also was very into the whole Cyberpunk thing after playing that so I decided to create this.
I mixed and matched different type of parts that I liked most and gave it a lil bit more touch.
